selection.rule: SHA256(vision-research-execution-v3-20260922: + filename), first 12 unused; no label-based selection
selection.primary_metric: all-attempt proportion within 10% of annotation-derived count; failures score zero
secondary_metrics: complete-cohort MAPE only if all answered
selection.answer_policy: Return the selected observed mask's count with approved/provisional review status; absent final verified artifact is failure
selection.input_policy: same question and 1/99.8 percentile preview for both arms; tool arm also gets original uint16 file
selection.retry_policy: one recorded attempt; schema-format repair and up to two internal scored execution rounds; no outcome retries
limitations: counting derived from segmentation labels, not original benchmark metric
12 images are a pilot, not a broad multimodal claim
CPU-only deployment and bounded catalog search
selection.amendment_reason: Complete new 72-attempt comparison after host sleep interrupted the original experiments. Same 96 KB tasks, programs, policy, inputs, references and models; both arms run afresh. All previous attempts retained. No accuracy-based selection.
selection.concurrent_deployment_note: Original four-worker experiment continues unchanged while this three-worker configuration variant runs; per-task CPU/memory limits are unchanged. Runtime is observational under this deployment load.
selection.runtime_condition: Awake host; audit OS sleep log at completion. Repeat validity is not guaranteed by caffeinate, which cannot prevent lid-close sleep.
